answer: Gate the economy's inlet with a ferrous-hard cost: every new agent must lock a slashing bond and finish a slow, verifiable work trial before it can transact, while its reputation accrues on a public ledge visible to all peers. A Sybil farmer cloning identities pays the bond and the time cost once per clone, and any cluster that cross-endorses gets its bonds slashed together, so mass forgery costs more than it can ever earn.
